failure-diagnosis-setup.install: Use this project's built suma-agent entry and prepare a dedicated model configuration.
failure-diagnosis-setup.configure: Save this read-only configuration on the execution node; inject the model secret only through SUMA_MODEL_API_KEY.
failure-diagnosis-setup.register: Synchronize the actual capability report, then have an administrator register and enable the dedicated diagnosis tool.
failure-diagnosis-setup.policy: Analyzes frozen failure evidence with at most one model request, without tools or a workspace. Diagnosis is advice; repair drafts require explicit review. A capability probe does not verify the vendor account.
